name: Natural Gas Services Group
outlook:
What Natural Gas Services Group says to expect

  • Full year 2026: Adjusted EBITDAThe Company now expects 2026 Adjusted EBITDA of $105 million to $108 million, compared to prior guidance of $103 million to $108 million.
  • Full year 2026: capital expendituresThe Company has narrowed its 2026 growth capital expenditure guidance to $60 million to $75 million. The updated guidance excludes acquisition consideration and continues to reflect investments in large-horsepower units, including a significant number of electric motor drive compression units. Maintenance capital expenditure guidance remains unchanged at $15 million to $19 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 9, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
